test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Among five friends Parineeta, Naira, Rinky, Shristi and Tina, Tina is taller than only three other friends. Rinky is tallest among all friends. Naira is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than Parineeta. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Among five friends Parineeta, Naira, Rinky, Shristi and Tina,

1) Tina is taller than only three other friends and Rinky is tallest among all friends.

Rinky > Tina > ____ > ____ > ____ 

2) Naira is taller than only one person and Only two persons are taller than Parineeta.

Rinky > Tina > Parineeta > Naira > Shristi.

∴ Here, 'Shristi' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shristi".**
